events.title: v2.2.1: Shorter Tutorial and Sharper Display
events.summary: The tutorial is now shorter and no longer blocks the screen, and you can skip the rest of it from the Game Menu. The first lesson now starts with a short look around the guild. The game is now drawn at the full resolution of your screen, so it looks sharper on screens larger than 1080p. Your existing saves will keep working. events.title: v2.2.0: In-Game Guide and Mouse Camera Controls
events.summary: The guild now has a guide. Open it from the Game Menu to read how each part of the guild works, with pictures from the game and answers to common questions. The camera has a settings page of its own, and you can now move and turn the camera with the mouse. Your existing saves will keep working. events.title: v2.1.4: Choose Your Tutorials and Unpaid Fees
events.summary: You can now choose which tutorials to play when you start a new game. When the guild cannot pay an adventurer's full fee, a new card explains what happened, and a small notice shows when the guild pays down its debts at night. Your existing saves will keep working. New: Choose Your TutorialsEvery new game now asks whether you want to play the tutorials, including your first one.You can play all of them, skip all of them, or tick only the ones you want. events.title: Update 2.1.2: Shorter Expeditions and Old UI Revamp
events.summary: Expeditions are now much shorter, and travel times are counted in hours instead of days. The map shows more of what your adventurers are doing, the save and load screens have been rebuilt, and you can now quick save with F5. Your existing saves will keep working. Shorter ExpeditionsExpeditions now take about a third of the time they used to. events.title: Update 2.1: Spellbook, Communication Crystal and Calendar
events.summary: The guild has taken on a new trade. Adventurers can now order magic scrolls from you, and you write every one of them by hand. You can order supplies from the city through the communication crystal and keep track of everything on the new calendar. The town also feels more alive: people come and go, and charter members will leave if they are unhappy. events.title: New Item Feature: Interested Classes
events.summary: Adventurers now make smarter choices when looking for items. They consider their class before deciding what they are interested in.This means item requests should feel more natural. A Wizard, for example, is much less likely to want equipment that does not fit their role.Different classes will now look for different kinds of gear based on what makes sense for them. events.title: Game Direction
events.summary: Hello everyone,Adventurer's Guild Manager was previously known as Under the Banner, but we've decided to take the project in a completely new direction. We've reworked nearly every aspect of the game, from its overall vision to the art style and presentation.
